correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Lagrange cardinal-derivative recurrence and eliminated its constant mode with d_n=y_n-y_{n-1}. The two alternating companion matrices produce a (k-1)-dimensional monodromy; the submitted exact quadratic/cubic Schur polynomials, quartic reduction and positive coefficient certificates are consistent with the formulas and checked source checker. Independently constructed numerical Lagrange matrices for k=2,3,4,5 at nine ratios (0.01 through 100); BDF2–4 parasitic spectral radii remained below one, BDF5 crossed radius one at the stated reciprocal thresholds and was unstable on both exterior intervals. Infinite-range conclusions derive from exact positive-coefficient rational certificates, reciprocity, Descartes and the simple-root gcd, not these finite eigenvalue tests. The BDF1 case has no parasitic root. At endpoints the constant solution and simple -1 mode are semisimple in the difference recurrence.
residual_risks: Only homogeneous two-periodic positive-step zero stability, not arbitrary mesh products or nonlinear convergence.
